description: Start number7even's free website check for a business's existing website. It reads the public pages (about 1–2 minutes) and builds a private preview: the business's own texts and pictures in every design, a check of security, sovereignty and visibility to AI, and a spec with a fixed price. Returns the private link to give the person; nothing is ordered or paid.
name: start_website_check
